arrivalEntryId.description: The arrival this cargo came on: required for SHIPMENT, null for ADJUSTMENT

colonists.description: New colonists, 0 or more; they land in Unassigned

deltas.description: Resource key to change; {} for none

reason.description: At most 200 characters after trimming; may be blank

setTo.description: Resource key to new amount, turned into a delta under the colony lock; {} for none. A key may not also be in deltas.

resources.description: Every resource the adjustment names, sorted by key

version.description: The colony version the preview saw; send it as expectedVersion

days.description: 1 or more; no limit beyond what the database can store

arrivals.description: Every arrival day in the span, as runs

shipmentsAfter.description: null when no shipment schedule is set

note.description: To the site owner; at most 500 characters

slug.description: The address /c/<slug>: 3 to 40 of a-z, 0-9 and single dashes

characterName.description: At most 60 characters after trimming; blank or null clears it

roles.description: Unarchived roles in display order, Unassigned included

shipments.description: null when no shipment schedule is set

lastChange.description: What Undo would rewind; null when there is nothing to undo

confirmSlug.description: The campaign's address, typed to confirm

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

membership.description: null when the caller has not asked to join

day.description: The colony day after the change

label.description: What the change did, e.g. 3 days pass · Day 44

code.description: Shown as BENY-XXXXX-XXXXX; run /link code:<it> in the server

request.description: null when the caller has never asked

maxAmount.description: null for no maximum; at least minAmount

characterName.description: At most 60 characters after trimming; blank or null clears it

clamped.description: A bound stopped the change (capped at the maximum or floored at the minimum)

requested.description: The change asked for; after minus before is what applies

archived.description: A system resource (food) can't be archived

maxAmount.description: null for no maximum; at least minAmount

botInviteUrl.description: Adds Beny Bot to a Discord server; null until DISCORD_CLIENT_ID is set

discordServer.description: null when no Discord server is linked

campaignName.description: 1 to 80 characters after trimming; the site owner sees it

discordAnnounceChannelId.description: A text channel of the linked Discord server

discordDmChannelId.description: A text channel of the linked Discord server

discordReminderChannelId.description: A text channel of the linked Discord server

daysUntil.description: nextDay minus day; always at least 1

nextDay.description: After today; null keeps the current next arrival, or day + interval when there is none

body.description: At most 2000 characters; line breaks allowed

day.description: 0 or more, past or future; must stay the same unless the entry is CUSTOM

earlierDay.description: The nearest day before fromDay with an entry this viewer sees; null when none

entries.description: Ordered by day, then write order

laterDay.description: The nearest day after toDay with an entry this viewer sees; null when none

today.description: The colony's current day, for Jump to today
